title: Hero Skill Kit Read-Only Catalog API
purpose: Expose inert/read-only hero skill kit catalogs through backend GET endpoints without connecting them to battle runtime, UI HP bar, skill activation, status activation, or balance systems.

endpoints.description: Read-only summary with counts, runtime flags, source paths, validation-friendly statistics.
Read-only hero skill kit schema metadata.
Read-only 5★ full skill kit catalog converted from approved source.
Read-only 6★ launch_base + Borea extra premium skill kit catalog.
Read-only lookup by canonical hero_id across 5★ and 6★ catalogs.

loader_rules: Create a backend loader that reads JSON files from /app/data/design/hero_skill_kits/ only.
Loader must be read-only and lazy/cache-based.
Loader must not write files, modify DB, mutate catalogs, or normalize data in-place.
By-hero lookup must use canonical hero_id only and must not query MongoDB for ownership or activation.
Summary endpoint must expose explicit runtime flags proving catalogs are inert.
absolute_rules: No status icon HP bar activation
Do not modify runtime kit JSON files
Do not import these catalogs into battle runtime
Do not connect these catalogs to frontend combat runtime
Do not create a UI in this task
acceptance_criteria: Read-only route module created and registered
All proposed GET endpoints return HTTP 200
Summary endpoint reports 6★ extra premium entries = 1
Summary endpoint reports total catalog entries = 33
By-hero endpoint works for a 5★ canonical hero, e.g. greek_atalanta
By-hero endpoint works for a 6★ canonical hero, e.g. greek_athena
By-hero endpoint works for Borea greek_borea but does not activate her
By-hero endpoint returns 404 for unknown hero_id
No runtime import from battle_engine.py or frontend combat files
report_required: Summary payload key counts and flags
Explicit confirmation that hero skill kit catalogs are read-only and NOT connected to battle runtime or HP bar runtime
